nexuscore.name: NexusCore Administration Framework
error.no-permission: &cYou do not have permission to do that. &8(&7{node}&8)
error.rate-limited: &cYou are running commands too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
error.internal: &cThat command failed. Ask an administrator to check the server log for id &f{id}&c.
error.unknown-player: &cNo player named &f{name}&c is known to this server.
confirm.rejected: &cThat confirmation is not valid &8({reason})&c. Run the command again to get a new one.
player.vanish.enabled: &aYou are now vanished. Other players cannot see you in the world or the player list.
teleport.sethome.limit: &cYou already have the maximum of &f{limit}&c home(s). Delete one with &f/delhome&c.
teleport.homes.none: &7You have no homes yet. Save one with &f/sethome <name>&7.
teleport.setspawn.success: &aServer spawn set to your current position.
teleport.back.none: &cThere is nowhere to go back to yet.
teleport.request.self: &cYou cannot request a teleport to yourself.
moderation.unban.success: &aUnbanned &f{target}&a. The record is kept in their history.
player.seen.offline: &f{target}&7 was last seen &f{ago}&7 ago. First joined &f{first}&7.
gui.admin.disabled: &cThe NexusCore admin panel is disabled on this server. &7Use the /nexus commands instead.
